source_observations: The local Python compiler fallback is extractive: it segments source lines into blocks, scores them using query-term overlap plus structural heuristics, then returns selected original lines in source order.
The local query is used for retention scoring and is not appended to compressed_text.

The server JavaScript engine has a local default policy; optional neural reranking uses a BGE cross-encoder and can auto-enable outside Vercel when dependencies/model are available, so exact model/runtime identity becomes relevant if that path is ever tested.
CCR replaces removed blocks with retrieval markers and can retrieve original blocks; the hosted persistence path stores original removed text in owner-scoped Firestore records with TTL.
The hosted CCR marker helper simpleHash is a small non-cryptographic integer hash plus length, which is unsuitable as an F2 evidence identity/digest without replacement.

Hosted domain preprocessors are intentionally lossy transformations: documented behavior includes dropping JSON null/empty fields/timestamps, truncating long strings, stripping code comments/docstrings, collapsing stack traces, deduplicating log messages and conditionally filtering DEBUG/TRACE.

The coding-agent proxy preserves system/developer messages, avoids elevating compressed history to system role, preserves structured tool protocol/tail messages, and generally fails open to original context on network/5xx/rate/empty-compression failure.
Hosted precision/API paths require a key and expose paywall/credit behavior after free quota. No hosted/provider path was invoked in this research stage.

transferable_mechanisms: CCR-style retrieval marker concept for omitted evidence
do_not_transplant: Firestore as a second truth/evidence store
TTL deletion as canonical evidence lifecycle
lossy domain preprocessing on canonical/evidence-bearing text
hosted API/paywall dependency for a core cognition path
neural relevance scores as truth or completion authority
required_f2_adapter_contract: ContextView remains derived/rebuildable; UnifiedDB/source artifacts remain canonical authority.
Every view binds query identity, source evidence IDs plus cryptographic digests, compressor source identity, policy/model identity, budget and deterministic kept/dropped decision metadata.
Omitted evidence is referenced back to canonical source rows/artifacts; do not copy it into a second mutable truth store merely to make retrieval possible.

Mandatory evidence classes must be pin-capable and non-droppable: negative results, UNKNOWN outcomes, contradictions/counterhypotheses, authority/effect receipts, causal ancestors and explicit safety/provenance boundaries.
Different GRID cells/queries receive separately identified ContextViews; one current-query view must not silently become global memory.
If any learned reranker is used, exact checkpoint/tokenizer/runtime/build identity and deterministic/replay behavior must be measured before credit.

strongest_positive_finding: A deterministic extractive query-aware selector plus canonical-source retrieval references could reduce bounded F2 ContextViews without creating a second state authority, provided F2 adds stronger provenance, cryptographic identity and mandatory-evidence pinning than upstream exposes.
strongest_disconfirming_finding: Upstream optimization is answer/query relevance, not F2 evidence-obligation completeness. Its documented lossy preprocessors can remove timestamps, nulls, comments, stack frames or DEBUG/TRACE records that may be exactly the negative/provenance/causal evidence needed by a counterhypothesis or later GRID cell.
counterhypotheses: F2 Emergent Retrieval may already produce sufficiently bounded ContextViews, making a separate compression policy needless complexity.
Query-aware selection may improve immediate answer relevance while degrading cross-cell reasoning, counterhypothesis preservation or later causal reconstruction.
Simple deterministic pinning plus source-aware retrieval may outperform learned reranking once F2 measures evidence-obligation recall rather than answer-only recall.
A compression layer can increase total latency and verification cost enough that token savings do not improve whole-system efficiency.

claims_seen: 100 percent Oracle recall at a fixed 35 percent keep budget

next_discriminator.design: Pin exact local source SHA and disable neural/hosted paths. Build a synthetic F2 evidence set containing query-relevant facts, a contradiction, an UNKNOWN effect outcome, authority/effect receipt text, causal ancestors and distractors. Compress at a bounded ratio for query A, repeat deterministically, then switch to query B/counterhypothesis. Measure mandatory-evidence recall, exact retained-byte equality, canonical-reference resolvability, deterministic repeat identity, query-switch recoverability and latency/token reduction.
acceptance_floor: 100 percent recall for explicitly mandatory F2 evidence obligations
zero invented or rewritten retained evidence on the extractive path
all omitted evidence resolvable to canonical source identity
repeat output identical under exact pinned engine/policy identity
query switch can recover previously omitted evidence without mutating canonical state
